description.narrative: The development objective of the recurrent cost component of the ARTF is to provide a coordinated financing mechanism so that the Government of Afghanistan can make predictable, timely, and accurate payments for approved recurrent costs related to: i) salaries and wages of civil servants, and ii) government operating and maintenance expenditures, except security.
